conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: I am looking at these Paris to New York flights for May 10 to May 20, and I need to keep the round-trip under $850.

Do not ask about specific airlines, departure times, or onboard amenities. Once the agent confirms it is filtering for flights at or under $785, end the conversation immediately without sending a closing thank-you message.
